mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS create_by_name, CASE WHEN r.create_by = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mine FROM bi_report r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by WHERE (r.create_by = #{userId} OR r.shared = 1) AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND r.dataset = #{cube} ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.create_by = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.id DESC
